identificationModule.briefTitle: Serplulimab Combined With Anti-VEGF Antibody in Advanced Lung Adenocarcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Serplulimab Combined With Anti-VEGF Antibody and Platinum-based Chemotherapy in Treat-naive EGFR/ALK-negative Advanced Lung Adenocarcinoma, a Single Arm Clinical Trail

descriptionModule.briefSummary: In order to further evaluate the efficacy of immunotherapy combined with antivascular therapy in the real world, we used Serpluimab combined with Bevacizumab and platinum-based chemotherapy in previously untreated EGFR/ALK-negative advanced non-squamous NSCLC patients, to evaluate the efficacy and safety of this regimen.

conditions: Stage IV Non-small Cell Lung Cancer

armGroups.label: study arm
armGroups.description: This is a single arm study.

interventions.name: Serplulimab and Bevacizumab injection
interventions.description:
Serplulimab, 4.5mg/kg, intravenous injection, D1,Q21, until the disease progressed or showed intolerable side effects.

Bevacizumab injection, 7.5mg/kg, intravenous injection, D1, Q21, until the disease progressed or showed intolerable side effects.

Platinum-based chemotherapy: pemetrexed combined with carboplatin, D1-2, Q21, a total of 4 cycles.

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 100 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events [Safety and Tolerability]
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of Participants With Abnormal Laboratory Values and/or Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
